title: Where Models Converge and Humans Diverge: A Coverage Framework for Distributional Pluralism in Open-Ended Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.05576v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: When a large language model (LLM) writes Harry Potter fanfiction, it can produce fundamental elements of the Hogwarts universe, such as recognizable places and characters. Human-written Harry Potter fanfiction, however, typically includes these fundamentals and much more, incorporating stylistically irregular content and relationship-diverse plotlines. This gap between LLM and human writing has been noted across a variety of domains. LLMs tend to produce "average" writing, while human writing contains more diverse content that covers a broader distribution. Existing work has shown the existence of this distributional "gap". We take a further step by providing a systematic framework to measure coverage of the human response distribution and identify which regions model samples reach or miss. translated_title: 模型收敛而人类分歧之处：开放式生成中分布多元性的覆盖框架
translated_abstract: 当大型语言模型（LLM）撰写哈利·波特同人小说时，它能够生成霍格沃茨宇宙的基本元素，例如可辨识的地点和角色。然而，人类撰写的哈利·波特同人小说通常不仅包含这些基本元素，还包含更丰富的内容，融入风格不拘一格的写作和关系多样化的情节线。LLM与人类写作之间的这种差距已在多个领域被注意到：LLM倾向于产生“平均化”的写作，而人类写作包含更多样的内容，覆盖更广泛的分布。现有工作已经证明了这种分布“差距”的存在。我们更进一步，提供了一个系统性框架来衡量模型对人类响应分布的覆盖程度，并识别模型样本能够到达或遗漏哪些区域。我们的论文提出了一个以人类为基准的框架，利用某一主题上人类写作的经验分布来衡量分布性多元（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了一个以人类写作为基准的覆盖框架，用于衡量LLM在开放式生成中对人类响应分布的覆盖程度，识别模型收敛而人类分歧之处，从而系统性地揭示LLM倾向生成“平均化”内容而人类写作分布更多元的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a human-grounded coverage framework that systematically measures how well LLM samples cover the distribution of human responses in open-ended generation, pinpointing where models converge to "average" outputs while human writing remains distributionally pluralistic.
